Verified OEM Replacement Part That Fixes This Code

LG OEM Washer Door Lock Switch Assembly

Primary OEM Ref: EBF61315801 · Cross-Ref / Alternate: EBF61315802 / AGM73610701 (Magnetic Door Plunger)

🛒 Check OEM Part #EBF61315801 on Amazon.com →

* Always match OEM Part EBF61315801 with your appliance model sticker before ordering.

⚠️ Failure Symptom & Factory Service Manual Root Cause

Symptom on machine: When you press Start, the door does not make the locking click and after a few seconds the washer chimes with dE, dE1, or dE2.

Verified technical root cause: Burned-out PTC thermal actuator inside the door lock switch assembly or broken magnetic door plunger.

🔧 Step-by-Step DIY Inspection & Replacement Checklist

  1. Push firmly on the right edge of the door while pressing Start: if the door latch hook aligns properly and still won't click locked, the EBF61315801 switch has failed electrically.
  2. Pop off the outer spring clamp on the rubber door gasket, remove the two Phillips screws holding the lock on the right side of the opening, and swap in the new EBF61315801.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (Error dE / dE1 / dE2)

What is the difference between dE1 and dE2 on an LG washer?
dE1 means the door switch contacts never closed when the door was shut; dE2 means the switch sensed the door closed, but the internal locking bolt inside EBF61315801 failed to engage.
